title: Fill-Only worker request
description: What a browser worker is told to do for exactly one page. Value-free: the values themselves live only in the private action package under .jobloom/, which this envelope identifies by hash and never inlines.

locale.description: One bounded contract, shared with page observation and non-disclosure policy registration.

allowed_origin.description: Loopback only while the executable surface is a local semantic replay. A production adapter requires its own supervised live acceptance test.

action_ids.description: Ordered. The worker performs these and nothing else.

operations.description: No click, submit, navigate, press, download or evaluate. Every Next, Continue and final action belongs to the user, so the worker has no way to leave the page it was given.

predecessor_checkpoint_sha256.description: Null only at page_index 0. Otherwise the checkpoint of the page before this one, which is what makes the page chain a chain.
